hero_title: Turn your product team from cost center to revenue engine.
hero_subhead: Run our methodology and walk away knowing exactly what your product should optimize for, what to build next, and why — with your whole team aligned.
hero_cta_primary: Schedule a consultation call. Totally free.
hero_quote: Your product is playing a Productivity game. Your North Star is Weekly Active Users. It moves when you improve breadth, depth, and frequency. That means your next three builds should focus on activation, retention, and channel expansion.
hero_quote_caption: This is what clarity looks like. This is what we produce.
pain_1_p: Features ship. Adoption doesn't follow. You can't tell if it's the product, the market, or the prioritization.
pain_2_p: Every team tracks something different. Nobody agrees on what winning looks like. Roadmap decisions become political.
pain_3_p: Customers on every channel at all hours asking the same thing over and over.
method_1_p: One session. Your team leaves with one metric, four inputs that drive it, and a prioritized list of what to build next. No more guessing. No more politics.
method_2_p: Is your product solving the right problem for the right person? We dissect your market position across six dimensions and surface the gaps before they become expensive mistakes.
method_3_p: What are you most likely wrong about? We identify the highest-risk assumption in your strategy and design the cheapest possible test to validate it before you build.
os_p: AI customer support built for e-commerce. Connect Shopify, WhatsApp, Instagram, and every channel your customers use — your agent handles the routine, you handle the growth.
cta_claude_p: Connect the Bonsai OS to Claude and run the full methodology as a native Claude experience.
cta_step_1: Go to Claude connector settings
cta_step_2: Enter a name (e.g. "Bonsai") and paste the MCP URL
cta_step_3: Ask Claude: "hi claude i just connected the bonsai connector, what can we do together?"
cta_us_p: We facilitate live, bring your industry benchmarks, and stay until it clicks. For teams who want a human in the room.
